issue_request: FHIR-19307 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary issue for FHIR-core CodeSystem. It asked to remove the statement that polyhierarchical code systems must use the trial-use subsumes extension, and to replace it with property-based guidance for additional parents plus operation-result equivalence whether hierarchy relationships are explicit properties or nested concepts.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git 80086b8f22b9b182c473fbb7b7a446d7aafbd37c, but that commit changes Subscription notes only. Git pickaxe identified c27b4eaede30c4537c55ae885110719ef3067ae0 as the actual CodeSystem application: it removed the subsumes-extension wording from source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml and added property/operation guidance.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml defines parent and child concept properties and uses properties for polyhierarchies in the Concept Hierarchy section. Later Published issue FHIR-39262 deliberately rephrased the same paragraph to distinguish nested single-tree hierarchies from property-based polyhierarchies, explaining why the exact 2018 replacement sentence is no longer present.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already satisfies the seed issue: the bad subsumes-extension assertion is absent, parent/child properties are defined for hierarchy relationships, property-based polyhierarchy guidance is present, and CodeSystem operation equivalence remains stated.
